inputs.text: These handouts look less like genuine care than a way to keep people focused on immediate benefits while decisions about FDI, jobs and AI are made out of public view. Bigger monthly aid for women, Rs 8,000 household coupons, free pumpsets for farmers and promises to fishermen help sell the story of progress as inevitable—but the people positioned to benefit from investment and technology remain unnamed. That silence is the part worth watching.
